game.name: Diario : Rebirth Moon Legend (Japan)
game.desc: Diario: Rebirth Moon Legend is a tactical role-playing game for Xbox 360. This game is a remake of the Rebirth Moon game released on Playstation 2, but adds many things such as additional missions downloadable on the Xbox Live, an online ranking of the best players but also a new game mode asking you to climb to the top of a tower composed of 50 dungeons populated with monsters!
